parsed.explanation: The upper bound depends on the cut count (5), but the quoted passage explicitly omits that count and Section 5 merely invokes it. A short counting sentence would suffice: at most |B|-1 internal B-boundaries and the endpoint q require cuts in A, while at most |A|-1 internal A-boundaries require cuts in B; endpoint coincidences only reduce the number. Thus at most |A|+|B|-1 new cuts are needed.
